column1: Why is CSS transform: translateX() significantly more performant for sliders than manipulating left or margin-left?
column2: transform: translateX() runs on the GPU Compositing thread without triggering Layout (Reflow) or Paint in the browser rendering engine, maintaining 60fps.

column1: What occurs in the browser rendering pipeline when left or margin-left is animated?
column2: The browser triggers Layout (Reflow), recalculating geometry for affected elements, followed by Paint and Composite, causing CPU frame drops.

column1: What does the CSS property will-change: transform signal to the browser rendering engine?
column2: It instructs the browser to promote the element to its own dedicated GPU compositing layer (CompositedLayer) ahead of time.

column1: Why should will-change: transform be used judiciously and only on active animated elements?
column2: Excessive GPU layer promotion consumes substantial VRAM/system memory and can degrade overall device performance.

column1: What is the mathematical formula in JavaScript to cleanly wrap any integer index (including negative numbers) into the range [0, total - 1]?
column2: ((index % total) + total) % total

column1: In JavaScript, why does -1 % 3 evaluate to -1 instead of 2?
column2: JavaScript's % operator is the remainder operator (which retains the sign of the dividend), not a true mathematical modulo.

column1: Which TouchEvent property provides the initial horizontal touch coordinate during a touchstart event?
column2: e.touches[0].clientX

column1: Why must changedTouches be used instead of touches during a touchend event?
column2: During touchend, the finger has left the screen, so e.touches is empty, while e.changedTouches contains the touch points that just ended.

column1: What is the geometric condition used to identify a deliberate horizontal swipe while allowing normal vertical scrolling?
column2: Math.abs(deltaX) >= threshold && Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)

column1: What does the CSS property touch-action: pan-y do on a touch-enabled container?
column2: It tells the browser that horizontal touch gestures will be handled by JavaScript while vertical scrolling remains native and unblocked.

column1: Why are touch event listeners often registered with { passive: true }?
column2: It guarantees to the browser that preventDefault() will not be called, allowing instantaneous scrolling without waiting for JS execution.

column1: What is the purpose of aria-live="polite" on the slider's live caption container?
column2: It informs assistive technologies (screen readers) to announce caption updates gracefully when the user is idle, without interrupting ongoing speech.

column1: What is the difference between aria-live="polite" and aria-live="assertive"?
column2: aria-live="polite" waits until the user/screen reader is idle before announcing, whereas aria-live="assertive" interrupts immediate announcements.

column1: How should pagination dots be marked up for accessibility in an image slider?
column2: As <button> elements with role="tab", aria-selected="true|false", and descriptive aria-label attributes (e.g., 'Slide 1 of 3').

column1: Why is event delegation on the document or parent container preferable to attaching individual click handlers to each pagination dot?
column2: It eliminates listener memory leaks and automatically handles dynamically re-rendered dots without needing to re-bind event listeners.

column1: Which keyboard keys should be handled for sliding when a modal gallery is open?
column2: ArrowLeft (to navigate to previous slide) and ArrowRight (to navigate to next slide).

column1: How do you prevent ArrowLeft and ArrowRight keyboard events from triggering slide changes when a text input or textarea inside a modal is focused?
column2: Check if e.target is an input, textarea, or contenteditable element, and ignore arrow key navigation if true.

column1: What happens if you transition an image track using transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)?
column2: The track animates horizontally with an ease-out curve that starts quickly and decelerates smoothly into the target slide position.

column1: Why should images in a modal slider beyond the first slide have loading="lazy"?
column2: To defer downloading offscreen images until necessary, saving user bandwidth and speeding up modal display.

column1: How does the slider UI handle single-image case studies gracefully?
column2: It hides previous/next arrows and the pagination dots container (display: none) while displaying the single slide and caption.

column1: In a zero-framework slider, how is the track offset calculated for slide index i?
column2: track.style.transform = `translateX(-${index * 100}%)`

column1: What happens when you click a pagination dot with data-action="go-to-slide" and data-slide-index="2"?
column2: The event delegation dispatcher parses dataset.slideIndex, passes integer 2 to goToSlide(), and transitions the track to translateX(-200%).
